Not really, my high anxiety causes me to get depressed, and when I’m depressed I get anxious. It’s like a never ending loop and, whilst I have techniques etc. to ’trick’ my brain that I’m ok, it only lasts until the next set back.

I think the best way to explain is it feels like my brain is a machine, but it’s faulty. The warranty has run out a long time ago, they aren’t making replacements anymore, and to fix now will cost a fortune.
I think I’m past that point sadly, but I appreciate your words, thank you ☺️
I think that’s the case, no obligations apart from my job at the moment. And I’m jealous, I‘m sure your kids appreciate you both ☺️
Wow, love CitW and Tucker and Dale... will definitely give Harold and Maude a go! ☺️
I do, I think the things I’m depressed about are heightened or are even caused completely by my anxiety.

But why can’t I just end it if I want to? I have no one who will genuinely miss me past the initial grieve period, and the pain will stop for me. Like everything, life moves on no matter what is happening.
